title: Sunflower and pumpkin seed flapjack

ingredients.text: 280 G Sugar Brown Light Soft Fairtrade

children.text: Preheat oven to 170ºC & line foil tins with parchment/grease. In a large pan/ bratt pan melt the butter golden syrup and sugar.
Once melted & combined fold in the oats and seeds.
Divide equally between the tins (1200g) & press down firmly & evenly
Bake for approx 30 minutes until golden brown & firm. Be careful not to overcook (should be moist & chewy not hard & crunchy).
Remove from oven & allow to stand in tin for 60 minutes
Turn out onto wire rack & leave to cool completely
Once completely cool portion into 12 9cm x 5cm rectangles as required.

title: Sourdough Starter

ingredients.text: 100 G Strong White Bread Flour 1.5kg (V)(ORG) FLOWHISTR1.5KG

children.text: In a bowl mix together 100g water with 100g strong white bread flour transfer into a clear plastic container you need to have good visibility the following day add a further 100g water and 100g strong white bread flour on the third day some bubbles may appear pour away half the mix and then feed again a further 100g water and 100g strong white bread repat again on the fourth & fifth day on day 6 it should have taken on a sour aroma and have the appearance of bubbly and light once this is established carry on the daily feeding but reduce the quantities by half.

children.text: 4 hours Knock back the dough by folding it building up more gluten at least 4 times.Prove the dough till its double in size shape the dough into a tight ball for the final shape flatten into a square shape then fold in the cornors and form into an oval shape seam side down lightly flour the top and place into a proving basket prove at room temp for another 2 hours score the dough before bakeing at 230 deg for 25 mins then check add some ice cubes to the oven and bake for a further 25 mins the loaf should dark in colour and hollow sound when tapped allow to cool completly before slicing.

children.text: Start by soaking all the seeds in 175ml of boiled water overnight the following morning start by mixing all the ingredients together in a large bowl tip onto a lightly oiled surface use the heel of your hand push away the dough and then pull back repeat this stretching and tearing technique to build up the gluten for approx. 10 mins. Place in clean lightly bowl and cling film keep in a warm environment for

4 hours Knock back the dough by folding it building up more gluten at least 4 times. title: Custard Yo Yo's Rhubarb icing

ingredients.text: 175 G Flour White Plain Org Vegan

children.text: To make the icing drain the rhubarb blitz to a puree add 65g of softened butter sift in 130g of the icing sugar and add the lemon juice mix well for a couple of minutes till it thickens transfer into a bowl and chill for 2 hours.

To make the dough sift the flour custard powder remaining icing sugar and salt into the bowl of the mixer using the paddle on allow speed to add the butter till it forms breadcrumbs add vanilla extract increase speed until the dough comes together.

Pre heat oven to 150 degrees line 2 trays with parchment paper roll the dough into balls about 40g each place on baking tray leaving enough space gently press the back of a fork to spread them out. bake for 25 mins until the biscuits are dry underneath but not too much color cool on a wire rack.
To assemble make a biscuit sandwich with the fork side on the outside pipe about 20gm of icing and press 2 biscuits together.

title: Banana Cake with rum caramel

ingredients.text: 110 G Flour Self Raising White Org
100 G Nut Almonds Ground Vegan 2.5KG NUTALMGRO2.5K

children.text: Pre heat oven at 180 deg grease the dariole tins and dust with flour. Add butter and 70g caster and brown sugar in a bowl beat with the paddle attachment high speed for 3 mins add the eggs one at a time beat well each time. Sift flour almonds Horlicks salt cinnamon and bi carb add to the beaten mix in a separate bowl mash the bananas with the sour cream and 5 ml of rum add to the batter spoon the mixer into the dariole tins 3/4 the way up bake for 25 mins and cool on a wire rack.

Make the caramel place 200g castor sugar and 125ml water in pan bring to boil and then simmer for 8 mins until the mix starts to change color swirl the pan till a nice dark color take of heat stir in dbl cream and remaining rum return to low heat and simmer for 20 mins till smooth and thick.
Take cake out of the moulds and pour over the cooled caramel allow to drizzle down the side.

title: Coffee & Walnut Financiers

ingredients.text: 120 G Nut Almonds Ground Vegan 2.5KG NUTALMGRO2.5K
90 G Flour White Plain Org Vegan
35 ML Milk Whole Pasteurised Standard RT

children.text: Roast the walnuts at 170 for 10 mins when cool chop roughly and set to one side.

To make the batter melt the butter in a saucepan cook further till foaming swirl the pan to get rich golden brown colour remove from the heat and cool for 5 mins strain the liquor through a fine mesh and leave to one side.
Sift 220gm icing sugar flour baking powder and salt in a bowl add the almonds mix together.

Use the egg whites in a bowl and whisk to froth them up a little dissolve 1/2 the coffee in a little boiling water add the egg whites and coffee to the dry ingredients then add the browned butter and mix the batter till thick skinny and smooth fold in the walnuts cover the batter with cling film and fridge for 2 hours.
Butter the side of muffin tins and dust with flour spoon in the batter mix to 3/4 of the way up bake them at 200 degrees for 25 mins test with a skewer comes out clean
Make the icing sift the remaining 250gm icing sugar add the dissolved coffee in the boiled milk add the glucose and mix till smooth.

Allow the cakes to cool for 5 mins from the oven then gently encourage them to fall out of the muffin molds place on a wire rack spread the icing on top and finish with a piece of walnut dust with icing sugar and a little bit of finely ground espresso powder.

title: Apple  olive oil cake  maple icing

ingredients.text: 350 G Flour White Plain Org Vegan
150 ML Oil Olive Extra Virgin KTC

children.text: Pre heat Oven to 180 grease and line the base of 23cm cake tin with parchment paper allow it to rise 3cm up the sides of the tin. 2.Place sultanas in a pan with 200ml of water simmer till all water been absorbed. 3.Sift flour cinnamon salt baking powder bi carb place sugar 2 eggs vanilla and the zest of the lemon in a bowl and mix using the paddle for approx. 7 mins on medium speed until colour is light and mix has doubled. 4.Use a spatula fold in the dry ingredients diced apples 75ml of water.
In a clean bowl beat 2 egg whites to soft peak and gently fold into the cake mix place mix into cake tin and bake for 55 mins or until a skewer comes out clean from the center of the cake.

Make the icing place butter sugar and maple syrup in a bowl and beat using a paddle until light and airy then add the cream cheese a bit at a time until smooth and thick. 7.Once the cake is cool cut in half horizontally spread half icing on bottom half place top layer back on scoop the remaining icing on top and evenly spread leave the sides free.

title: Pistachio & Rose water semolina cake

ingredients.text: 100 G Nut Almonds Ground Vegan 2.5KG NUTALMGRO2.5K
150 G Nuts Pistachios Green Peeled Kernel

children.text: Pre heat Oven to 180*C grease and line the base of 23cm cake tin with parchment paper allow it to rise 3cm up the sides of the tin.

Use the flat side of a knife crush the cardamom and discard the pod an blitz the seeds then add the pistachio and blitz until fine transfer to a bowl and add ground almonds semolina baking powder and salt mix and set aside.
Place butter sugar in a bowl and beat using a paddle until light and airy then add the eggs one a bit at a time the mix will curdle but dont worry this normal.
Add the dry ingredients folding them in by hand do noy over mix add the lemon zest lemon juice and 1/3 of the rose water and vanilla place into cake tin and level using a palette knife.
Bake for 1 hour until a skewer comes out clean.
Make the cream add yogurt creme fraiche icing sugar other 1/3 of rose water and whip by hand till thick - keep in the fridge.

Make the syrup by mix the lemon juice remaining rose water and 100g castor sugar bring to the boil and turn of heat keep it warm as soon as the cake comes out of the oven drizzle all the syrup over the top add the finely chopped pistachio over the top serve with the whipped cream on the side.

5 G Nut Almonds Flaked Vegan 2.5KG NUTALMFLA2.5K
1.2 L Milk Semi Skim Poly RT

children.text: Bring 600 ml milk to the boil take off heat and add the vinegar when the milk curdles add a few ice cubes. When fully separated strain the chenna into a clean cloth pull the sides together so it is fully wrapped up rinse under cold water to get rid of vinegar smell and taste.

Squeeze all excess water out and hang for couple of hours until all water is out you should be left with the whey this needs to knead gently to release the oils bring together and roll into 12 equal balls and press then down.

Bring 50g sugar and 150ml water to the boil with the ground cardamon add the disc and poach and a highish heat for 9 minutes they should have doubled in size allow to rest in the syrup till cool take out of the syrup and gently squeeze out any excess syrup.
Bring the remaining 600 ml milk to the boil with the saffron add the 150g sugar reduce the heat and keep stirring till it thickens cool and this can be kept in the fridge.
To serve gently warm the saffron cream adds a few pistachios and almonds and a few saffron threads then add the balls (rasmalia) reheat and serve once warm.

children.text: Add 150ml water with 150g sugar and 4 crushed cardamon make it till it reaches sticky stage then add the rose water and cool.
Mix the flour milk powder and bi - carb together in a bowl add the melted butter and yogurt and mix into a dough if required add a little milk divide the dough into 10 mini balls.
Deep fry the dough balls till they are golden brown in colour and cooked throughout drain off any excess oil and add to the warmed syrup to allow them to absorb some of the syrup.
Serve the Gulab Jamun with a little syrup on the side and garnish with some chopped pistachios.

children.text: Pre heat oven 180 deg grease & line 30 x20 cm tray with baking parchment paper.
Mix Almonds and cashew nuts roast for 10m mins allow to cool and roughly chop into small pieces.

While nuts are cooling place 80gm of oats in food processor and blitz but not too far mix with the rest of the oats and set aside dry roast the seeds in a frying pan toast them evenly add these to the chopped nuts add the chopped pitted dates and oat mix.
Place the butter sugar date syrup and zest of the orange in saucepan over a medium heat mix add the rose water and pour over the dry mix stir together and tip onto the lined tray press out evenly.
Bake for 30 mins until a nice darkish colour cool for 30 mins before cutting into 12 rectangles before they set hard as they will crumble when hard.

title: Posh beans on toast

children.text: Soak the haricot beans & ham hock in plain water overnight. Boil beans until tender drain well. Simmer the ham hocks covered in water for 5 hours until tender.
Peel & dice onion to 1/2cm. Halve & deseed chillies finely chop. Finely chop garlic. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Halve & deseed peppers cut to 1cm.

Heat 20ml oil add cumin seeds & sizzle for 2 minutes. Then add the onion garlic & chilli sweat down for 4 minutes & add the spices stirring for 2 minutes. Add the cherry tomatoes & chopped tomatoes reduce the heat and simmer until reduced by 2/3.
Slice the sweet potato lengthways to 1cm thick weighing approx 105g. Drizzle with 25ml oil & roast on a lined tray at 190*C for 18 minutes.
Add the baby spinach & the beans to the sauce & mix well.
Poach an egg drain well. Remove the crusts of the loaf break down to small pieces bake until crisp. Pick & rouchly chop parsley.
To assemble lay the toast on a plate spoon over the beans and top with a poached egg.

title: Shakshuka

ingredients.text: 150 ML Oil Olive Extra Virgin KTC
10 G Herb Parsley Flat Leaf Bunch

children.text: Preheat oven to 165*C
Peel amd slice onions wash and slice peppers. Halve deseed and finely dice the red chilli Finely chop garlic. Wash and roughly chop parsley.

Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the onions and peppers and season with salt and pepper. Cook on a medium heat until just softened. Add the garlic and chilli cook for a further 2 minutes. Sprinkle in the cumin coriander and smoked paprika cook out the spices for a minute or two. Stir in the tomato puree cook for a couple more minutes until the paste starts to separate. Add the tinned tomatoes.
Simmer for 15 minutes uncovered until reduced a little. Taste after 5 minutes and add the sugar When the sauce is reduced by half stir in 3/4 of the parsley. Remove from the heat.

Divide the tomato and pepper sauce into individual containers make a small wells in the sauce. Break an egg into the well repeat with the remaining eggs. Place in the oven and cook for 10 minutes or until the whites are just set and the yolks are still runny. The core temperture is 75*C. Sprinkle over the remaining parsley .

children.text: Finely slice the onion. Deseed the peppers and finely slice. Finely chop the garlic. Finely slice the chillies with the seeds. HOT PAPRIKA OIL
Heat the oils over a medium heat and add 50g red pepper 5g onion 20g chillies taking care not to splash the hot oil.
Cook gently stirring often to distribute the heat until lightly golden and excess water has evaporated.
Remove from heat and stir in the paprika. Cover tightly and leave to infuse for 1 hour before straining. SHAKSHUKA
Soak the haricot beans overnight and bring to the boil in clean cold water. Cook until tender and drain.
Heat 15g pomace oil and add the remaining onions and peppers with the cumin seeds. Cook until softened under a cartouche stirring occasionally. Add the remaining paprika and cook for 1 mintue.
Pulse chop the tomatoes until finely chopped. Add to the pan with 500g water. Cook for 30 minutes and then chill. TO ASSEMBLE
Mix the yoghurt with the microplaned zest and juice of 1 lemon.
Pick and coarsely chop the coriander.
Put 6g paprika oil into a cold egg mould. Crack in 1 egg. Bake for 5 minutes @ 180°C.
Reheat 180g shakshuka place into 12oz cup carefully put the baked egg on top.
Top with 20g lemon yoghurt 1g coriander and 1g finely sliced green chilli.

FOR THE CANNELINNI HUMMUS; Place the beans garlic and tahini in a food processor with 40ml lemon juice and 50ml olive oil. title: Pastry

children.text: Preheat the oven 180ºC. For the pastry: Cream together 3 eggs and 125 gm sugar add the 300 gm Flora Buttery and mix together gradually add the flour and salt until smooth and leave to rest for 1 hour.

Roll out the pastry to 4mm thick on a lightly floured surface. Cut out 10 11cm circles and 10 8cm circles of pastry. Use the larger circle to line a non stick mini muffin tin and chill. Chill the 8cm circles as these will be the lids.
For the filling: Peel quarter and core the pears and apples then slice thickly into a bowl. Zest and juice the lemon.
Mix together 120 gm sugar (retain a little to sprinkle over later) the cinnamon thelemon juice and zest and stir gently into the pears and apples.
Place the pear and apple slices into the lined muffin tins. Cut the remaining butter into 10 and dot each pie with butter and sprinkle with chopped rosemary.
Place the smaller circles on top of the sliced pears and apples. Seal the edges well. Make a small hole in the top to allow steam to escape.
Egg wash with lightly beaten egg and sprinkle with the remaining sugar.
Bake at 180°c for 30 mins until the fruit is tender and the top is golden brown.

title: Blondie with a Dark Chocolate Frosting

ingredients.text: 135 G Cheese Soft Cows Milk Tunworth

children.text: Preheat the oven 170ºC. Grease a 26cm x 32cm x 5cm brownie tin. Scrape the seeds from the vanilla pod.

Put the Flora Buttery and 100gm (per 10 portions)of the white chocolate into a heatproof bowl and place over a saucepan of barely simmering water (don't let the base or side of the bowl touch the hot water). Melt stirring from time to time and heat only until just melted. Cool.

Whisk the eggs and sugar in a mixer until thick and creamy (when you lift out the beaters the mixture should leave a ribbon trail on the surface of the batter). Stir in the vanilla and the melted chocolate mixture until well combined.

In a separate bowl sift together the flour and salt. Using a spatula fold the flour and coconut into the batter in batches - flour/coconut/flour/coconut/flour - folding until just combined. Gently fold in the remaining white chocolate.
Scrape the mixture into the prepared tin and spread to the edges. Bake for 15 minutes or until the edges are beginning to pull away from the sides. Cool in the tin.
To make the frosting place the cream cheese margarine and icing sugar into the bowl of a food mixer and Whisk together until smooth and thickened. Melt the dark chocolate and whisk into the mixture.
Spread the mixture over the cooled blondie and cut into 10.

children.text: Preheat the oven 150ºC. Place silpat mats or grease proof paper onto a large baking tray. Fold in the sugar and whisk again on a low speed until the mixture is glossy.
Pipe the meringue directly onto the paper forming a nest with a well in the centre and bake in the preheated oven for at least 1 hour.
Remove the baking tray and allow the parchment to rest on a wire rack in the oven. Remove the meringue once a finger impression cannot be made. Cool before using.

Whip the cream with the icing sugar reserve 20gm of the icing sugar for dusting. Pipe the cream into the centre of the nest. Layer the blackberries on top of the cream and dust with the remaining icing sugar.

Wash and cut the strawberries thinly slice. 2.Separate the egg whites and beat on a medium to high speed until a stiff peak is achieved. Fold in the sugar and whisk again on a low speed until the mixture is glossy. 3. Pipe the meringue directly onto the paper forming a nest with a well in the centre and bake in the preheated oven for at least 1 hour. 4. Remove the baking tray and allow the parchment to rest on a wire rack in the oven. Remove the meringue once a finger impression cannot be made. Cool before using. 7. Whip the cream with the icing sugar reserve 20gm of the icing sugar for dusting. Pipe the cream into the centre of the nest. Layer the blackberries on top of the cream and dust with the remaining icing sugar.

title: Blackberry Panacotta

children.text: Rinse & drain the blackberries leave to dry. Cut the vanilla pod in half and scrape the seeds from the pod. Place the vanilla pod into the milk and cream.
Heat the cream and milk in a pan but do not boil. Whisk in the sugar.
Soften the gelatine in cold water once soft squeeze any excess water out then whisk into the warm cream.
Spoon the blackberries into the base of 10 small 140ml dishes (keep some bck for garnish). Strain the cream mix through a fine strainer and pour into the dishes.
Chill over night to set then serve with a blackberry on top.

Cream together the cream cheese and sugar then slowly beat in the eggs (Careful not to over work as the mix may split). Add the vanilla essence. Cut the blackberries into 1cm pieces and mix into the cream cheese mix.
Pour the mix into the pastry case and cook for approx 40 minutes or until the mix is almost set.

Dust with icing sugar. Neatly cut into 10 and serve.

title: Mango Tart aux Tan

children.text: Slice the mangos and apples into 1cm thick slices.
Preheat the oven to 200ºC.
Melt the butter in a small frying pan add the sugar and allow to melt slowly without stirring over a medium heat tip the pan frequently to help the sugar to melt.
When the sugar is golden brown add the mango and apples and cook for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile role out the puff pastry and place on top of the frying pan and push the sides down to tuck everything in.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes allow to cool slightly before tipping out.

title: Pastel de Tres Leches (Three Milk Cake)

ingredients.text: 600 ML Milk Whole Pasteurised Standard RT

children.text: Separate the egg yolks and whites. Heat the oven to 180ºC. Melt the butter. Line a gastro try with greaseproof paper. In an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment combine egg whites baking powder and salt and beat on medium speed until soft peaks form 2-3 minutes.
Add yolks to the whites and beat until completely combined. With the mixer running slowly add sugar until combined. Remove the bowl from the mixer. Using a rubber spatula fold in melted butter.

Sift 40g (per 10 portions) flour on top of the mixture and fold in to combine. Repeat with the remaining flour folding in 40g at a time. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake until golden and a cake tester inserted into the middle comes out clean 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer to a wire rack.

About 5 minutes before the cake is done whisk together the three milks and set aside. As soon as the cake is removed from the oven pour the milk mixture over the entire cake. The cake should absorb all the liquid within 3-5 minutes. Set cake aside and let stand until cool. Cover cake well and transfer to the refrigerator to chill at least 5 hours or overnight.
Lightly toast coconut shavings.
When ready to serve the cake whip cream to soft peaks spread over cake cover toasted coconut and cut to desired size.

title: Alfajores

children.text: Start with all the ingredients at room temperature. Separate the egg whites and yolks. (use the whites in something else)
Cream the butter vanilla and icing sugar. Add the egg yolks.
Then add the corn flour (previously sifted with the salt and baking powder). Do not overwork just incorporate the ingredients as lightly as possible.

Keep the dough in the fridge for at least 3 hours. Roll it to 4mm and freeze the dough slightly. Cut 3cm circles and cook at 150ºC for approx. 10 minutes. The alfajores will look white and tender to the touch but they will firm up once cold.
Roll in desiccated coconut. They freeze well finished but to keep the crumbly texture crisp just freeze the raw dough and cook when needed.

Place in the preheated oven and bake stirring occasionally for approx. 90 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the correct consistency.
Mix apricots with pistachios spoon these over the rice pudding- or serve separately for allergy requirements.

title: Churros

children.text: Mix the sugar and cinnamon and leave in a tray or bowl.
To make the sauce- put both chocolates syrup and cream in a pan over a gentle heat stirring all the time till melted and silky smooth- leave in a warm place.
In a large bowl sift the flours and add the salt and make a well.
In a separate bowl mix the oil and 450ml boiling water pour this into the well beating to remove any lumps then bring together to a sticky dough leave to rest for at least 10 minutes.
Add the dough to a piping bag fitted with a star shape nozzle pipe directly into hot oil fry till golden then drain onto kitchen paper and sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar.
Serve with the chocolate sauce.

For the topping separate eggs & whisk whites slowly add remaining sugar until thick & glossy. Pipe onto silicon paper & bake at 120*C for 20 minutes. Allow to cool then crumble over posset.

Melt butter then mix with crushed digestive biscuits. Spoon into pots and press down to about 3 mm thick. Place cooled toffee into piping bag and and pipe a layer of toffee onto cooled biscuit base.

Peel and slice bananas and arrange evenly on to toffee layer. Whip double cream with sugar and vanilla extract to soft peak. Pipe cream evenly over bananas. Dust with cocoa powder chocolate shavings and icing sugar.

title: TEN Dessert Salted Caramel Pannacotta

ingredients.text: 187 ML Milk Whole Pasteurised Standard RT

children.text: Heat milk vanilla seeds and 125g sugar in a pot. Soak gelatine leaves in cold water.
Once milk is hot remove from the heat and stir in squeezed gelatine leave to cool for 15 minutes or blast chill until body temperature.
While the milk is cooling down semi whip 750ml cream. Once milk is cool add a little of the whipped cream to the milk then fold the milk into the cream a little at a time.
Pour into pots & leave to set in the fridge for at least 2 hours.

For the salted caramel; caramelise 330g sugar until golden stirring regularly. Romove from heat. Slowly add the cream & salt be aware of the steam. Return to stove to dissolve sugar. Allow to cool to room temperature then pip on top of pannacottas.

title: Pear & Praline Pot

ingredients.text: 150 ML Milk Whole Pasteurised Standard RT

children.text: Boil or steam condensed milk for 2 & 1/2 hours allow to cool down naturally.
Peel core & quarter pears then cut each quarter into 4 slices lengthways. Juice the lemon. Halve the vanilla pods then scoop out seeds with back of knife keep each pod separate.

Boil 260g caster sugar 500ml water lemon juice cinnamon & seeds of 1 pod. Then add sliced pears reduce heat. After 3-4 minutes when pears are starting to soften remove from heat place pears on greaseproof paper & remove excess syrup.
Pipe toffee into bottom of pots. Once the pears have cooled arange the pears against the side of the pots.

Gently warm the milk remaining vanilla seeds & 70g caster sugar. Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water. Once the milk is hot remove from heat. Drain gelatine squeeze out excess water then mix into hot milk.
Semi whip the cream then fold the cream into the milk. Pipe cream into pots allow to set in fridge.

For the praline; toast the hazelnuts in the oven. Make a caramel by heating 150g caster sugar remove from heat when golden brown. Add the hazelnuts to the caramel stir then tip out flat on to parchment paper. Once cooled blend praline but keep course. Sprinkle on top of set cream then pipe toffee in three small areas.

ingredients.text: 50 G Sugar Brown Light Soft Fairtrade
550 ML Milk Whole Pasteurised Standard RT
90 G Nut Almonds Ground Vegan 2.5KG NUTALMGRO2.5K

children.text: For the crumble; combine 90g butter 80g caster sugar 90g ground almonds & 90g flour. Rub in until breadcrumb consistancy. Spread on a tray & bake at 165*C for 10 minutes. Remove from oven fork over & allow to cool. Juice the lemon. Halve the vanilla pod lengthways remove seeds with back of knife. Set aside.

Place the compote in the bottom of the pot then the custard then top with crumble.

title: Rhubarb & Ginger Fool

ingredients.text: 550 ML Milk Whole Pasteurised Standard RT
35 G Sugar Brown Dark Soft Fairtrade

children.text: For the compote; trim wash & roughly chop the rhubarb. Bring orange juice & 300g caster sugar to the boil. Add rhubarb simmer on low heat for 4 minutes then remove from heat & cling film pot.

For the Orange Custard; zest the oranges then add to 400ml milk with half a vanilla pod scraped out. Mix remaining 150ml milk with egg yolk corn flour & 120 caster sugar to make a paste. Gently boil milk then whisk in yolk mix slowly until custard starts to boil again & thicken. Pour the custard on to a tray cover with cling film to stop a skin forming & chill.

For the Chantilly Cream; add 1/2 vanilla pod scraped out to 250ml double cream gently whip & add icing sugar. Pipe into middle of pot then sprinkle remaining crumble around the edges. Finish with stem ginger.

children.text: Pre heat Oven to 180 deg.

Peel the pineapples and roughly chop blend 400g of flesh into a fine puree transfer into a sauce pan and b ring to boil simmer for 3 minutes then remove from the heat keep half of the puree for later and then strain the other half through a fine mesh sieve you should get 60ml of juice set aside as this is for the icing if its short top up with water.

Place flour 240gm of castor sugar ground star Anise and salt in a bowl make a well in the middle add 200gm of the pineapple puree sunflower oil the egg yolks (keep the whites for later) orange zest and vanilla seeds whisk all together to form a batter.

Place the egg whites in a bowl with an electric mixer and using the whisk attachment beat on high power for 30 seconds until frothy and lemon juice (or 1.25 tsp Cream of tartar) continue to whisk until soft peak then add 50gm of caster sugar continue to whisk until stiff glossy peaks form using a spatula fold into the batter mix. Pour the mix into a non-greased chiffon cake tin not more the 3/4 cm from the top bake for 50 mins check with a skewer invert the cake tin it wont fall as its not greased allow to cool.
To make the icing sift the icing sugar and mix with 6oml of pineapple juice stir until smooth.

Cut the cooled sponge horizontally on the bottom half spread the cooked strawberries spoon the cream on top

title: Millionaires Shortbread

ingredients.text: 250 G Flour White Plain Org Vegan
5 G Vanilla Pods Papua New Guinea

children.text: Pre heat Oven to 180*C grease a 20 cm square cake tin with butter and line with baking parchment paper let the paper rise over the top.

Mix the Cornflour and Icing sugar in a bowl. add 40g of caster sugar mix on a medium speed slowly add melted but cooled 175g of butter beat till combined add the vanilla then on slow speed add the sifted flour and salt till the dough comes together.
Tip into the cake tin press evenly and bake for 25 mins until golden brown cool completely.

For the caramel place the remaining sugar and water in pan place on a medium heat bring to the boil for around 12 mins until the sugar has a deep dark brown color remove from the heat and carefully add the butter and cream whisk to combine all once the butter has melted pout over the cooled shortbread and set in the fridge.
Melt the milk chocolate in a bowl over a pan of water. Do this also with the white chocolate.

Pour the milk chocolate over the set caramel and spread out with the back of a tablespoon. Drop a few blobs of the white chocolate on top of the milk chocolate and spread out with a fork to make a pattern. Leave to cool until it's nearly set but not quite solid. Lift the caramel shortbread out of the tin and cut into 12 squares.

title: Lacha Paratha

children.text: Combine flour and oil in a bowl. Slowly add the water and bring together for a soft dough. Need for 5-15 minutes either by hand or in a mixer until a smooth dough is achieved.
Place dough into a lightly oiled bowl and cover before leaving for 15-20 minutes to rest or place in the fridge until needed.
When ready to make the Parathas put a dry frying pan over a medium heat.
Split the dough evenly into 10 pieces roll each piece into a ball. Cover the balls so that they dont dry out. Melt the butter in a pan.

Flatten a ball of dough using your fingers before lightly dusting in flour and rolling out to a diameter of approximately 12cm. Brush with butter and sprinkle with salt before rolling the dough into a long sausage to close up the disc. Even the sausage out using your palms before taking one side of the dough and curling it into a spiral. Tuck the end piece into the middle and press down until fixed into place.

Lightly dust both sides with flour and roll out once again this time to a diameter of approx. 20cm. Brush the excess flour off from the disc. Turn the heat up on the pan slightly and place the bread into the pan. Let the bread cook for 45 seconds on one side before flipping over and cooking for 35 seconds on the other side. Brush the bread with a little more butter and turn over cook for a further 30 seconds before brushing the other side with butter and flipping over and cooking the bread until golden brown slightly crispy and cooked through.

title: Pork Pie

children.text: Combine the meat half of the salt pepper shredded sage worcestershire sauce mustard and nutmeg. Roll into 10x100g portions and leave in fridge for 15 minutes.
Mix the flour and remaining salt. Bring 200ml water with butter to the boil then stir into the flour to form a dough leave to cool.

Roll out the pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 5mm. Place the pork balls onto the pastry and cut around each one about double the size pinch the pastry all the way around to form a neat parcel and ensure there are no holes or gaps.
Any remaining pastry can be rolled out and used as a lid by - egg wash it onto the pie.
Egg wash the whole pie and place on a non stick tray make a small hole in the top to allow for steam to escape.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the core temperature has been reached (Eng 75ºC Scot 82ºC).
Cool and serve.

Halve the courgettes lengthways slice across at an angle to 1/3cm. Julienne the carrots. Halve & core the peppers finely shred. Remove stalk from kale cut to 2cm x 5cm strips. Halve cucumber deseed then slice across to 1/3cm. Rub in 100g salt leave in a colander for 20 minutes then wash off and drain. Halve red chillies deseed then finely dice. Quarter red cabbage remove core then finely shred. Rub in 100g salt leave in a colander for 20 minutes then wash off and drain. Preheat oven to 180*C.
Combine the white wine vinegar & sugar then split in half add the red chilli to one half. Coat the cucumber in the chilli pickle the red cabbage in the other mix well then allow to drain.

Blanch the kale in boiling water then season with 1g salt. Add 20ml oil to a hot pan then colour the courgettes. Drain the gherkins then julienne. Shred the coriander reserve. Trim the spring onions cut thinly across at an angle into iced water. Toast the sesame seeds in a hot pan then allow to cool.
Cook the rice in double volume of water to rice with remaining salt then allow to drain keep warm.
Spread the chicken over a baking tray cook in the oven until core reaches 75*C then remove & keep hot.
When starting to build fry eggs in remaining oil.

title: Spiced Pork  Feta & Roasted Tomato Baklava

ingredients.text: 1.2 KG Pork Shoulder Roast Jnt B/Less 3.5-5.5kg
400 G World Cheese Feta 200gm Pack The United Fresh Consortium Lt 63516E
ingredients.item: World Cheese Feta 200gm Pack The United Fresh Consortium Lt 63516E

children.text: Halve the cherry tomatoes. Peel halve & thinly slice onions. Peel & mince garlic. Defrost filo pastry. Melt the butter. Zest the orange. Preheat oven to 150*C. Crumble the feta.

Lay the halved cherry tomatoes on a lined tray skin-side down. Place in oven for approx 1.5 hours until semi- dried then allow to cool. Season the pork roast in oven for approx 3 1/2 - 4 hours until pullable allow to cool enough to pull discard fat & skin shred slightly if needed.

Toast the fennel seeds in a pan when cracked add the oil & onions cook until translucent. Then add the garlic & pork. Add the passatta honey & remaining salt & pepper. Reduce heat allow sauce to thicken then remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Increase oven to 180 *C.

Brush base of tin liberally with melted butter. Lay filo to cover bottom brushing each side with butter. Divide the filling into 2 spread one evenly over the bottom top with cherry tomatoes & feta. Then lay filo on top brush again add the remaining filling then close with more pastry & brush with butter.
Cut lines into the top layer to show portions. Bake for 30 minutes until golden brown all over.
While the baklava is baking dissolve the sugar in the boiling water add the orange zest & cayenne reduce until syrup.
Remove the baklava from the oven pour over the syrup allow to stand for 5 minutes then serve.

title: Chavot Chorizo & Rose Harissa Frittata

ingredients.text: 100 G Chorizo Magno Alejandro Sliced 100g Brindisa

children.text: Preheat oven to 165*C. Cook the potatoes in salted water until tender then drain and peel while warm. Cut into quarters. Thinly slice the spring onions across at an angle.

In a medium sized pan saute the potatoes until golden brown. Add the chorizo cook for 2 minutes do not allow to dry out. Add the spring onions artichokes & peppers cook for a few minutes until softened. Beat the eggs with the milk.
Add the egg mixture to the pan then add the rose harissa. Cook for 5 minutes on a low heat on the hob then transfer to the oven for 7-8 minutes.

title: Thai Green Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 200 G Paste Thai Green Curry Mai Siam
ingredients.item: Paste Thai Green Curry Mai Siam

ingredients.text: 30 G Sugar Brown Light Soft Fairtrade
30 G Chicken Bouillon Powder Chefs Pass

children.text: Dilute the bouillon in the water. Trim the baby aubergines and cut into eighths wash the baby corn very finely slice the lime leaves pick the basil leaves top and tail the green beans. Take a table spoon of the curry paste and coat the chicken.

Place a suitable size saucepan over a medium heat and add the oil. Add the chicken and brown the meat all over (increase the heat if required) followed by the aubergine and continue to cook over a medium heat until dark and golden on all side. Add the remaining paste and lime leaves and continue to fry for a further 5-10 minutes until aromatic and fragrant. At this point add the stock and coconut milk. Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 10 minutes or until slightly thickened (dont over reduce).

When the sauce has achieved the required consistency add the green beans and simmer for a further 3-4 minutes followed by the baby corn. Return to the boil and cook until the core temperature has been reached (75ºC Eng 82ºC Scot) approx. 4-5 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Add the juice of the limes sugar fish sauce and fresh basil. Combine. The dish should be a balance of salty sweet sour and spicy. Serve immediately.

children.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Defrost the avocado.

Halve the squash and de-seed. Wrap both parts in foil and place into the preheated oven. Roast until tender and soft approx. 1hour. Meanwhile peel and cut the onion into 1cm dice. Cut the celery into 1cm dice and wash. Cut the pepper into 1cm dice. Peel and finely mince the garlic. Finely mince the chilli. Pick the coriander leaves (reserving for later) and finely shred the stalk. Drain and rinse the beans. Drain the jalapenos. Roughly chop the avocado to a coarse paste. Dilute the bouillon with the water.

Place a suitable size saucepan over a medium heat and add the rapeseed oil. Add the Holy Trinity celery/onion/pepper and sauté until they begin to caramelise. Add the garlic minced chilli coriander stalk soy sauce and spices. Continue to cook for 2-3 minutes.

Add the chopped tomatoes beans and stock to the pan. Bring to gentle simmer. Meanwhile remove the squash from the oven unwrap scoop out the flesh and place into a food processor. Blitz to a smooth puree. Fold the puree through the chilli along with chipotle. Allow the mixture to simmer gently for 20-25 minutes stirring occasionally.

Place the taco shells into the preheated oven for 2 minutes remove and set aside. Place 2 (per portion) of the taco shells into a suitable size serving bowl and lightly smash. Top with a portion of the pumpkin chilli avocado

title: Cheese and Bacon Turnover

ingredients.text: 144 G Pasty Turnover Cheese Bacon PC

children.text: Pre-heat oven to 190°C before attempting to bake.
Remove required amount of product from the freezer.
Place onto a solid flat baking tray allowing 5cm around each product. This will allow an even bake.
Return the box to the freezer ensuring the liner is covering the product.
Place products into the oven and set timer 30 / 35 mins.
Once complete wash and sanitise your hands following the hand washing procedure.

Once the buzzer sounds using oven gloves probe the product with a sanitized probe. Ensure the core temperature is above 75°C (82°C) in Scotland. If the temperature is below 75°C/ 82°C return the product to the oven until 75°C/ 82°C is achieved.
When the product has come out of the oven using tongs place the product in the hot unit / counter.
Check the core temperature of the products every hour. Check that the products are being held above 63°C. Dispose of product after 4 hours.

title: Yakitori Grilled Pork

children.text: For the master stock recipe; remove the rind of the oranges with a peeler use the skin and add to a pot along with 12L water soy sauce shao xing palm sugar ginger garlic cardamon cinnamon cloves star anise peppercorns liquorice root chillies & seeds bring to the boil then reduce heat & simmer for 4 hours. Drain and set liquid aside. Preheat oven to 120*C.
Lay belly in a deep tray pour over masterstock to cover lay greaseproof on top then cover tightly with foil.
Cook at 120*C for 6 hours then remove from stock lay upside down & remove bones and cartilage then remove skin. Return to a tray press with weight and chill leave pressing overnight.
Pass the stock through a chinoise chill and retain to use again. Top back up to 12lt with water before next use.
Cut pork belly into 120g rectangle pieces and skewer for service.
Add 200ml water to the teriyaki dressing and mix well.

title: Basmati Rice with Crispy Shallot

children.text: (Please note 2 sizes of chicken mince needed 450g of each 5mm & 8mm) Preheat the oven to 220*C. Line trays with grease proof paper. Place the peanuts onto a suitable size roasting tray and place into the preheated oven and cook until golden: 4-5 minutes.
Make the curry sauce as per recipe.

Peel crush and chop the garlic. Peel and dice the onion. Roughly chop the toasted nuts. De-seed the chilli and dice. Peel and chop ginger. Shred the coriander stalks and half of the leaves and pick the remaining leaves. Blend the bread to a crumb. Cut the limes into wedges.

Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the onions and cook on a low heat for 2 minutes add the garlic chillies and ginger. Cook for a further 3 minutes or until the onions are translucent. Remove from the heat and leave to cool. Blend to a paste with the chopped coriander stalks and leaves.
Beat the eggs with the milk add the paste garam masala breadcrumbs chopped nuts salt and pepper to the minced chicken leave to rest for 30 minutes .

Divide the mixture into 30 x 50gm balls place onto the baking tray and cook in the oven for approx. 20 minutes (turning through cooking) or until nicely browned and the core temperature has been reached 75*C.
Serve the balls in the curry sauce with jasmine rice and garnish with the picked coriander crispy onions and lime

children.text: Heat oil in a fryer to 180*C. Make the Bay Batter - Mix the batter mixture with water following the manufacturer's guidelines to get the correct consistency.
Cut the lemons into wedges (8 per lemon) removing the white pith and seeds.
Season the rice flour with 5g salt.
Lightly coat the fish in the seasoned rice flour then dip the fish into the Bay Batter. Remove the fish from the batter and allow to drip slightly to remove any excess batter.
Holding the tail place the battered fish into the fryer placing it away from the body to avoid hot oil splashing back.
When the fish is golden on one side turn using a fine kitchen spider.
Once the fish is golden on both sides remove from the fryer and place in a drip tray to remove excess oil make sure core temperature is 75*C Serve straight away.
Place chips in a basket in a seperate fryer and fry until golden then place in a bowl season with 5g salt and serve straight away.

title: Tagliatelle Carbonara

ingredients.text: 225 G Pancetta Whole Smk Salt And Cure
ingredients.item: Pancetta Whole Smk Salt And Cure

children.text: Crack the egg yolks into a bowl add the cream finely grate in the Parmigiano Reggiano and season with freshly cracked black pepper then mix well.

Dice the pancetta into 1cm removing the rind. Add the pancetta to a large frying pan and sauté over medium-low heat until browned and crisp around 5 minutes. Cook the tagliatelle in a large pan of generously salted boiling water for 2-3 minutes or until al dente (taste a piece before removing from the water).

Once cooked reserve 1/2 a cup of the boiling cooking water and transfer the pasta to the frying pan with the pancetta. Toss well and then immediately remove the pan from heat - this is crucial as to ensure the eggs do not scramble when introduced.

Now add the egg cream and cheese mixture tossing vigorously to ensure the sauce clings to the pasta and doesnt settle on the base of the pan. Add the pasta water adjusting as necessary to obtain a silky smooth sauce that completely coats the pasta. Continue to toss vigorously and stir through with a large pair of tongs.
Finish with freshly grated Parmigiano Reggiano and a healthy grind of black pepper.

children.text: Start by peeling the potatoes and cutting into 2cm cubes (see picture)
Par boil the potato cubes in the saucepan (should take about 5 minutes on a medium heat) drain and leave to one side
Peel and finely chop the onion and leave to one side
Next heat the oil in the sauté pan (do not over-heat) and then add the cumin seeds and mustard seeds to the oil
When the mustard seeds start to pop add the finely chopped onions to the saucepan and fry until golden brown
When the onions have caramelized add the ginger/garlic paste and green chilli paste to the saucepan cook for 10 seconds
Then add the plum peeled tomatoes and water to the saucepan and cook for a minute and then remove from the heat and blend the masala using a hand blender
Put back onto the heat and add the red chill powder turmeric salt and 1 whole green chilli to the masala
Cook the masala for about 10-12 minutes on a medium heat (cover with saucepan lid if masala starts spitting keep stirring quite regularly)

Add the par boiled potato cubes to the masala and cook in the masala sauce until the potatoes are completely cooked and slightly mushy (you may need to add water if masala dries up too much) you can also use the lid to steam the potatoes for 1-2 minutes
Lastly add the garam masala. Garnish with fresh chopped coriander

children.text: In a jug blender/mixer mix together the gram flour yoghurt and 500ml of water until smooth leave to one side. Peel ginger blend to a paste. Blend garlic to paste. Mix tamarind with 20ml warm water. Trim green chillies blend to paste. Peel & dice onions. Crush the ajwan seeds with the back of a spoon.
In a saucepan heat the olive oil
Add fenugreek seeds cumin seeds dried red chillies and carom seeds (ajwain) sizzle spices for 30 seconds
Add ginger and garlic paste cook for 30 seconds
Add onions and sauté for 2 minutes. Fry the pakoras seperately allow to drain well.
Add green chilli and salt followed by turmeric and red chilli cook for 1-2 minutes
Lower the heat a little and add the blended yoghurt and gram flour watered mixture
Add the remaining 2.5lt of water and now kaar (boil/simmer) the kadhi for a good 30 minutes on a low to medium heat (stirring frequently) adjust the heat as required

Once the kadhi has thickened and the gram flour inside the kadhi has thoroughly cooked (it should be a perfect pouring consistency) add the tamarind mixture cook for a further 1 minute. Chop the coriander.
Add garam masala and fresh coriander and cook for a minute
Add in the cooked pakoras and cook for a final 2 minutes

title: Black Pepper Tofu Udon Noodles

children.text: Place cracked black pepper on a tray and roast until browned/toasted approx. 7mins then place aside.
Meanwhile chop garlic and fry on a medium heat until golden brown then add oyster sauce and ketchup to the garlic and bring to a boil whilst whisking.

Dice Tofu in to approx. 1cm cubes.
Dredge diced Tofu in seasoned (salt & pepper) cornflour and fry (deep fry is most practical). Once completely cooked place aside in a layered steamer tray or a Tray with tissue to drain the oil.
Now prepare the veg by; cut the tenderstem broccoli into florets cut bell peppers into 2cm cubes cut red onions into 2cm wedges (separate petals) slice spring onions and chillies.
Place wok on a high heat add oil. Once hot add broccoli red peppers and onions. Fry for 2 mins (veg should still have a firm bite).
Add Tofu and fry for a further
2mins to heat through. Add noodles and the black pepper sauce to ensure everything is evenly coated.
Add chillies and spring onions. Garnish with coriander and crispy fried shallots to serve.

Thinly slice the cucumber on a mandolin place in the cold pickling liquor and leave for 1 hour or overnight.

Deep fry the butternut squash in clean oil at 180*C until golden brown then place on a wire rack on a tray cook in the oven at 180*C for 10-12 mins. Do the same for the aubergine deep fry until golden and the into the oven 8 mins.

Arrange the freekeh mix onto a flat platter. Dot with the yoghurt scatter the remaining shallots and herb on top

children.text: Cook the pasta in a large pan of rolling boiling water according to manufactures instructions - cook to al dente. Drain well and refresh under cold running water until cool.

Add oil & butter to a pan on a low medium heat & toast breadcrumbs for 3-4 minutes. Add garlic & thyme & stir over heat for a further 2 minutes or until the crumb is crisp & golden brown. Remove from the pan to a mixing bowl & allow to cool.

To make cheese sauce - Place milk cream cloves onion & bay leaf into a pan & bring to a simmer slowly. In another pan melt butter & add flour to create a roux. Cook out the flour on a medium heat for a few minutes. Pass milk through a sieve to remove cloves & bay leaf. Whisk the milk slowly into the roux mix until smooth.
Add salt remaining cheese mustard & white pepper. Whisk gently until cheese has melted. Mix cheese sauce & pasta together.
Portion into correct service dish (individual portions) top with more Cheese.
Cook in preheated oven 170*c for approx. 25-30 minutes. Ensure the core temperature reaches 75c ENG (82c SCOT).
Serve on correct service plate with salad and garlic bread.

title: Celeriac Soup With Walnut Gremolata (Ve)

ingredients.text: 200 G Herb Parsley Flat Leaf Bunch
100 ML Oil Rapeseed Extended Life KTC

children.text: FOR THE WALNUT GREMOLATA; Mince 2 garlic cloves. Zest the lemon. Toast the walnuts in the oven at 180*C till lightly golden leave to cool before roughly chopping. Pick the parsley leaves and finely chop. Add all the ingredients into a bowl and mix to combine. Season to taste with sea salt.
PREP; Peel half and finely chop the onion. Crush 4 garlic cloves. Peel and trim the celeriac then dice into small pieces. Peel and roughly dice the potato. Peel core and dice the apple.

In a large saucepan on medium high heat add oil. Sauté the onions for a few minutes till they are translucent. Add the garlic celeriac potato and apple. Cook for 3 minutes then add the vegetable stock and bring to the boil. Lower heat to a simmer cover and cook for 30 minutes or till the celeriac is tender.
Let soup cool a little before blitzing in a high-speed blender (in batches) till smooth. Season to taste with salt and freshly cracked pepper.
Serve with the walnut gremolata topping and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Butternut Squash  Leek & Gruyere Pithvier

ingredients.text: 500 G Chs Gruyere Block French Entremont
2 EA Eggs Medium Free Range 15 doz
100 ML Oil Rapeseed Extended Life KTC

children.text: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Line a couple baking trays with parchment paper.

PREP; Peel half and scoop out the seeds of the butternut squash. Slice into 0.5cm pieces. Finely slice the leeks wash and thoroughly drain. Grate the gruyere cheese. Finely slice the sage leaves. Whisk together 1 egg + 1 egg yolk. Pick thyme leaves.

In a bowl add the butternut nut squash oil picked thyme salt and freshly cracked pepper. Toss to coat and transfer to the lined baking tray. Roast for 10-15 minutes or till just tender. Remove from heat and chill.

In a Saucepan on medium heat add oil. Once hot add the leeks and sauté for 3-4 minutes or till softened. Add the sage salt and freshly cracked pepper and cook for a further 1 minute. Remove from heat and chill.
Defrost the puff pastry sheets and cut out 20 rounds in 15cm diameter (roughly the size of a small side plate). Place half the rounds on a lined baking sheet.

Sprinkle the centre of each pastry circle with a little grated gruyere. Layer slices of the squash leek and grated gruyere seasoning as you go. Keep layering till you have a dome shape about 5cm high. MAKE SURE YOU LEAVE A 2cm EDGE AROUND THE OUTSIDE. Egg was the edge and then drape another puff pastry round on top and press edge with a fork to seal it tight. Brush the pastry tops with beaten egg and mark a spiral or criss-cross pattern lightly into the pastry top.

title: Duck Fat Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.text: 100 G DUCK FAT IMS of Smithfield

children.text: Preheat the oven to 180*C.

Peel and cut potatoes into quarters. Place in a saucepan of cold salted water and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook for 5 until parboiled. Drain then return to the pan and shake well over medium heat to dry out and rough up the edges (this will help them crisp up when roasting).

Place the duck fat in a gastro tray then place in the oven for 5 minutes to heat. Remove from the oven carefully add potato rosemary strings and garlic cloves to duck fat and gently toss to coat. Return to the oven and roast for 45 minutes until golden and crispy turning potatoes halfway through. Season with salt and serve.

title: Orange & Cinnamon Roasted Creedy Carver Duck

children.text: Preheat oven to 180*C.
FOR THE GLAZE; In a saucepan add the honey zest and juice of the orange crushed cinnamon stick crushed garlic cloves and picked thyme leaves. Reduce the sauce by half.

Pat dry the duck breast with blue kitchen paper. Lightly score the fat with a sharp knife. Season with salt and leave for 10 minutes. Pat dry again and in a dry frying pan skin side down. Turn the heat up to medium low temperature and cook for 6-8 minutes or till the skin is crisp and golden. Pour off any excess fat as you cook*. Flip the breast over and seal the meat for 30 seconds. Transfer the duck breast to an oven tray skin side up and roast for 5-7 minutes or till core temp is 54*C brush duck with the orange glaze twice.
Remove duck from the oven brush one more time with the orange glaze and leave to rest on a wire rack for 5 minutes.
Slice and serve with roasted vegetables savoy cabbage and mulled cherry sauce.

Prepare tartar sauce to spec. Bring butter to room temperature. Preheat fryer to 170*C.

Steam the peas for 5 minutes and warm the cream. Blend together the peas cream & remaining salt and pepper until combined but not smooth. Lay a sheet of greaseproof on top to stop a skin forming allow to cool. Prep the baby gem leaves wash and drain well.
Fry the goujons until golden brown and core is 75*C drain and then keep hot.

children.text: Dice the chicken to 1.5cm. Peel halve & finely slice onions. Peel the ginger puree half julienne the other half. Puree the garlic cloves. Trim the green chillies deseed blend half and finely julienne the other half. Dice the butter to 1cm. Wash the rice 3 times under cold water then drain well.
Coat the chicken in the natural yoghurt ginger paste garlic paste chilli powder green chillies paste salt garam masala peppercorns mace cloves cardamoms cinnamon & bay leaves coat well.

Add the oil to a pan over medium heat then add the cumin seeds sizzle for 2 minutes then add the onions cook out for 3 minutes. Add the marinated chicken to the pan and cook for 4 minutes then add the water cover with a lid and bring to a simmer.

Add the rice to the pot stir gently then recover. After a minute stir again gently then recover. Once the water has reduced lower the heat keep covered and cook for another 4 minutes. Add the julienne ginger & green chilli crispy shallot diced butter and random spots of food colouring do not stir. Cover with foil then the lid allow 2 more minutes then switch off the heat and leave for 5 minutes. Roughly chop the coriander.
Remove the lid and foil add the coriander & rose water then gently lift and fluff the rice do not break the grains then serve.

children.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan
Add cinnamon stick (break into half) cumin seeds star anise black cardamom and bay leaf
Once spices are sizzling add onions and cook the onions until they are well caramelized this should take 4-5 minutes

Add green chilli and ginger and garlic paste cook for a minute or so add butter and add tomatoes followed by coriander powder cumin powder turmeric red chilli and salt mix your masala sauce. Cover the saucepan and cook for 4-5 minutes until masala splits and sizzles
Add the lamb to the sauce together with 200ml of water and mix cover the saucepan and cook for ten minutes (keep stirring in-between)
Check if the masala needs more water add if required and cover the pan and continue cooking for
15 minutes
Add the 100ml more of water to the masala lamb and cook for a further 10-12 minutes stirring in between)

Check to see how much cooking the lamb still requires add in the rest of the 100ml of water or more if required and cook for a final 15 minutes or as long as required for the lamb to completely cook (keep adding water if lamb requires further cooking cooking time very much depends on the cut and quality of your lamb)
Once the lamb is cooked perfectly add the fresh chopped coriander and finishing touch of garam masala cook for a final two minutes or so remove from the heat and serve.

children.text: Roast hazelnuts on a baking tray until golden remove the skins and roughly chop set aside. For the sauce.

To serve lay out the marrow/ courgette onto a serving plate pour over the hot tomato sauce ripe the mozzrealla and place on top of the sauce. Finish with tearing the basil leaves and sprinkling over with the hazelnuts.

Line a suitable size roasting tray with greaseproof and spoon ricotta onto the greaseproof breaking it apart (the flatter it is the darker and crispier it will become). Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Sprinkle the tomatoes with a little salt and a teaspoon of dried oregano then set aside to macerate.

Sprinkle over the croutons crumble over the baked ricotta and serve with the vinaigrette.

children.text: First make the cake. Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Grease and line the base of a 20cm sandwich tin.

Place the butter sugar and vanilla extract into a bowl and beat well to a creamy consistency. Slowly beat in the eggs one by one then fold in the flour and mix well. Tip into the cake tin and bake for about 20 mins until risen and golden brown. Set aside to cool completely.
While the cakes are cooling make the buttercream. In a large bowl or the bowl of stand mixer beat the butter and icing sugar together until smooth add the vanilla extract and milk and beat again.
Once the cake is cooled crumble into large crumbs. Add the butter cream and stir together.
Take chunks of the cake mixture and roll into balls transferring each ball to a lined tray or plate push a lollypop stick into each then put into the fridge for an hour to set.
Melt the white chocolate in the microwave blasting it and stirring at 10 seconds intervals until smooth.
Tip the colorant into another bowl. Take each of the chilled cake pops and dip into the white chocolate allowing it to drip off a little over the bowl.
Dip into the colorant then stand upright in a mug to dry at room temperature for an hour or in the fridge for 30 mins.

children.text: Put the ham hocks in a large pan with the stock ingredients. Cover with cold water. Set pan over a high heat and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to a simmer cook for 2 and a half to 3 hrs or until the meat falls from the bone. Leave to cool in the pan.
Grease a 1-litre terrine mould or loaf tin with the oil then line with cling film. Remove the hocks then strain the stock through a fine sieve into a pan. Set aside.
Shred the ham leaving some large chunks removing as much fat and sinew as possible. In a large bowl mix the ham with the mustard and parsley. Press the mixture into the prepared terrine.

Bring the reserved stock back to a rapid boil and reduce by half. You should have about 600ml/1pt liquid remaining. Remove from the heat. Meanwhile soak the gelatine in cold water for 5 mins to soften. Remove from the water then squeeze out any excess liquid. Add the gelatine to the hot stock and stir well.

Pour enough of the stock over the ham to just cover. Tap terrine firmly on a hard surface to knock out air pockets then cover with cling film. Chill for 3- 4 hrs or overnight. To make raisin puree: Boil raisins in water strain it and blitz it with just as little water as needed to blitz

children.text: Put the salt cod in a saucepan with enough water to cover it and add a bay leaf. Bring to just under the boil take the pan off the heat put a lid on it and leave to sit for 10 mins. Drain then put a clean tea towel over the pan cover and leave for 5 mins or so (this helps the potatoes dry out a bit).

Bring 300ml water and the olive oil to the boil in a saucepan. Take the pan off the heat and immediately add the flour in a slow stream whisking (use a balloon whisk) as you do so. You will end up with a batter if it is a little lumpy beat it hard. Leave to cool for about 5 mins. Beat in the eggs a little at a time until you have a smooth mixture you need to beat hard.

Put in a bowl cover and leave to cool completely. Form the mixture into balls bigger than walnuts but not as big as golf balls.

children.text: To make the crème pâtissière put the egg yolks and caster sugar in a bowl and whisk with electric beaters until pale and creamy. Whisk in the cornflour until smooth. Put the milk into a medium non- stick saucepan. Scrape the vanilla seeds out of the pod into the milk and bring to a simmer.

Remove the milk from the heat and gradually add to the egg mixture whisking constantly with a large metal whisk until it is thoroughly incorporated. Tip back into the saucepan and cook for 8-10 minutes over a low heat stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until very thick and smooth. There shouldnt be any floury taste remaining.

Pastry sheets - you can either bake 1/2 sheets of puff pastry or cut then bake. ( much easier if you cut then bake pastry) bake in between 2 cast iron trays using baking paper dusting with icing sugar evenly before you bake bake at 160c dry for roughly 12 -16 mins
Wash and slice your strawberries for decoration however desired.

To assemble spread jam on your base sheet of cooked pastry then pipe on creme pat (not to thick) then repeat the method 2 times to create layers garnish with a thin layer of creme pat and top with sliced strawberries and icing sugar.

Put the milk into a medium non- stick saucepan. Scrape the vanilla seeds out of the pod into the milk and bring to a simmer. 2. Remove the milk from the heat and gradually add to the egg mixture whisking constantly with a large metal whisk until it is thoroughly incorporated. Tip back into the saucepan and cook for 8-10 minutes over a low heat stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until very thick and smooth. There shouldnt be any floury taste remaining. 3. Pastry sheets - you can either bake 1/2 sheets of puff pastry or cut then bake. ( much easier if you cut then bake pastry) bake in between 2 cast iron trays using baking paper dusting with icing sugar evenly before you bake bake at 160c dry for roughly 12 -16 mins 4. Wash and slice your strawberries for decoration however desired. 5. ingredients.text: 100 ML Oil Olive Extra Virgin KTC

children.text: Add the oil HALF the mint leaves the chilli and the zest of ONE Lime to the blender and blitz to make the marinade.
Cut the feta into 3 pieces and add to the marinade. Best to leave to marinade overnight or at least a few hours.
Roast the feta in the oven at 200c for 5 min or till lightly golden around the edges. Leave to chill till needed.

Prep the watermelon (remove skin) cut watermelon into 1 inch thick slices. On a hot grill bar mark the watermelon on one or both sides (this depends on how fragile the watermelon is). Then cut in to rough 1 inch cubes.

children.text: Mix the warm water with the yeast then add the milk and oil.

In a mixing bowl mix the flour salt sugar and garlic & rosemary oil mix once mixed well add the milk water and yeast mixture. Mix on a low speed then with a spatula clean the sides and keep repeating until you have formed a dough. Once formed mix on a medium/low speed for 10/12 minutes. Combine sugar salt and smoked paprika mixing until well combined. remove the fish from the sherry and roll in the rub until completely covered. leave to cure in the fridge for 2 hours
After 2 hours using a kitchen j cloth wipe off the excess rub. then roll in cling film completely tight. store in the fridge up to 3 days or freeze.

Plate the dish.

children.text: For the savarin dough sift the flour into the bowl of a small electric stand mixer fitted with a dough hook attachment and turn on to the lowest speed. Add the salt and caster sugar.
Dissolve the yeast in the milk then add this to the flour mixture. Turn up the speed on the mixer a little add the eggs and mix until the dough comes together.

Slowly add the melted butter until the dough tightens and all the butter is incorporated. Transfer the dough to a clean bowl cover with cling film and leave at room temperature until doubled in size. Return to the mixer and mix on a high speed for 2 minutes to knock the dough back.

Put the dough into a piping bag fitted with a large plain nozzle. Lightly grease six 7cm savarin moulds with the softened butter and dust with a little flour. Pipe enough savarin dough into each mould to fill it half full (cutting the dough with a pair of scissors to finish).
Cover with cling film and leave in a warm place again until doubled in size. Bake in an oven preheated to 200°C/ Gas Mark 6 for 8 minutes or until golden brown.
Turn out onto a wire rack and leave to cool.

Preheat the oven to 190*C/gas 5. 5. Meanwhile make the cobbler dough. In a food mixer or by hand cream the butter and remaining sugar together until very pale and fluffy. 6. Sift the flour baking powder and salt over the mixture and fold in with a little of the milk until well combined. Gradually incorporate the rest of the milk to give a sticky dough. 7. Flour your hands and form the cobbler dough into small rough balls. 8. Place them on a non-stick baking sheet brush with the beaten egg and bake in the oven for 6-7 minutes. 9. 9. Stir the blackberries into the pear mixture and transfer to individual ovenproof serving dish. 10. Arrange the part-baked cobbler balls on top of the fruit mixture and bake for 10-15 minutes until they are golden in colour. 11. Serve hot with hung creme fraiche.

children.text: Place the tin of coconut milk in the fridge - ideally over night.

Whisk the coconut milk with a hand held electric whisk until light and fluffy.

Place the dark chocolate plus 4tbsp of the reserved coconut water into a bowl and melt either over a pan of boiling water or by putting in the microwave in 10 second bursts and stirring in between each burst.
Gently fold the melted chocolate and optional almond extract through the whipped coconut cream.
Divide between four ramekins scatter with optional flaked almonds and serve immediately or chill until required.

title: Sausage roll

children.text: Peel and finely dice the onions. Mince the garlic. Pick and finely chop thyme and sage. Finely grate lemon zest and juice.
Sweat off onions and garlic for 2-3 minutes. Add lemon zest thyme and sage cook for a further 2 mins season with salt and pepper and cool.
Peel and grate apples add lemon juice and ensure all apple is coated.
Combine the sausage meat and the pork mince. Add one beaten egg the onion mix mustard and the grated apple.
Make a small patty cook in a pan to test seasoning adjust if required.
Place to sausage mix into a piping bag.
Separate the rest of the eggs mix the egg yolks for your egg wash.

Lay down a sheet of puff pastry. Egg wash the sheet and pipe a thick line approx. 2 inch wide of the mix. Fold the pastry over the mix. Crimp the edge with a fork and cut remaining edge of for neat nish.
Return to the fridge ensure the pastry is cold before cooking.
Pre heat oven at 180*c.

Sprinkle salt mix onto the egg washed sausage rolls and cut into 2.5 inches pieces.

children.text: Heat the oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 4 and line a 20cm square baking tin with baking parchment.

Melt the dairy-free spread sugar and syrup in a saucepan over a medium heat. Remove from the heat and tip in the oats raspberry and dried blueberries. Transfer to the tin packing the mix in with the back of a spoon.

title: Vietnamese meatball nuoc cham dip

ingredients.text: 70 G Sugar Brown Light Soft Fairtrade
130 ML Sauce Soy Tamari Kikoman G/F

children.text: To make the meatballs. Add the 30ml fish sauce and 30g sugar into a bowl then stir until the sugar begins to dissolve Finely chop the lemongrass and shallots mince the garlic 8g finely slice the green part of the spring onion and the 5g chopped chilli then add all of this to the bowl with the fish sauce and sugar. Mix well
Blend the beans in a robo coupe and then add this to the mix with the minced pork to the bowl along with a little salt then mix until well combined.
Equally divide the mixture into balls
For the glaze combine sesame oil ginger soy sauce honey and 30ml rice vinegar in a pan. Boil for around 5 mins to a syrup consistency
To make the dip finely chop the garlic 8g and 3g chilli then add to a bowl Add the rest of the fish sauce sugar rice vinegar lime juice and water and mix well until the sugar has dissolved
Cook the meatballs at 200oc for 10-12 mins untilthe core is 75*C
Once cooked roll in the glaze
